1	# WP-007: `loadConfig()` integer guards and bounds warnings
     2	
     3	## Description
     4	
     5	Enhance `loadConfig()` in `src/config/config.ts` to reject float values for numeric fields (falling back to defaults) and emit `console.warn` for out-of-range values without clamping.
     6	
     7	## Scope
     8	
     9	- `src/config/config.ts` — `loadConfig()` function
    10	- `src/tests/config.test.ts` — new test cases
    11	
    12	## Dependencies
    13	
    14	- WP-002
    15	
    16	## Acceptance Criteria
    17	
    18	1. `loadConfig()` returns the default value when a numeric field contains a float (e.g., `notesCardHeight: 220.5` falls back to `DEFAULT_NOTES_CARD_HEIGHT`).
    19	2. `loadConfig()` emits `console.warn` for each numeric field whose value is outside its allowed `[MIN, MAX]` range.
    20	3. `loadConfig()` does not clamp out-of-range values — they are passed through with a warning.
    21	4. New test cases in `config.test.ts` verify float fallback behaviour for at least one numeric field.
    22	5. New test cases in `config.test.ts` verify `console.warn` is called for out-of-range values (using a spy).
    23	6. `npm test` passes with zero failures.
    24	7. `tsc --noEmit` exits cleanly.
    25	
    26	## Active Pipeline Stages
    27	
    28	`implementation` → `qa` → `code-review` → `documentation`
